apple.name: NOIR Poker
apple.subtitle: Learn, play, review, repeat
apple.promotionalText: A quieter place to practice Hold'em. Learn at the table, review the decisions behind each hand, then replay the same deal to explore another line.
apple.description:
Every hand is a chance to understand your next decision.

NOIR Poker is an offline no-limit Texas Hold'em practice app. Take a seat against computer opponents, learn through guided hands, and return to the moments that mattered. No account is needed.

LEARN AT THE TABLE
An interactive beginner tutorial introduces hole cards, position, blinds, betting rounds, raises, folds, all-ins and side pots. Four guided hands lead into a hand you play yourself.

MAKE YOUR OWN DECISIONS
Choose tables with 5–9 players, three difficulty levels and eight training styles. Practice sizing bets, reading public actions and adjusting to different opponents. Table hints and hand rankings are available as you play.

REVIEW THE REASONING
After a hand, explore your decisions and the opponents' actions. Reviews consider the information available before each decision, the price to continue and assumed opponent ranges. They use heuristics and simulation estimates, rather than knowing the opponents' hidden cards or judging a choice solely by the result.

REPLAY THE SAME DEAL
Restore the original cards, dealing order and starting stacks. Try a different decision and see how the hand develops. Browse locally saved game records to revisit earlier play.

EXPLORE THE ODDS
Enter hole cards and a board in the standalone win-rate calculator. Compare win and tie probabilities and see the next cards that can put a hand ahead. Depending on the scenario, results use enumeration or sampling.

PRACTICE ON YOUR TERMS
Play offline with locally bundled artwork and music. Adjust table size, starting blinds, difficulty, styles, hints, sound, music and vibration. The app supports 11 interface languages.

All chips are virtual, have no cash value and cannot be purchased or redeemed. There are no prizes, real-money wagers or human opponents. Reviews and odds are learning aids and do not guarantee optimal play or profit.

One upfront purchase unlocks the complete app. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

en-US.reviewNotes: No login or demo account is required. All practice uses virtual chips with no cash value, chip sales, redemption, prizes or real-money betting. The installed app bundles its code, fonts, artwork, music and review logic locally. On first launch, tap Take a seat. The header menu opens Beginner tutorial, How to play, Game records and Win Rate Calculator. Finish a hand to open its decision review or replay the original deal. Settings includes language, table size, starting blinds, difficulty and computer styles. No remote production server URL is configured. The app is a paid upfront purchase without in-app purchases or subscriptions.

apple.promotionalText: 从互动引导到独立对局，从决策复盘到原牌重打。在安静的离线牌桌上，理解每次行动的理由，探索另一种选择。
apple.keywords: 德州扑克,离线,单机,训练,练习,复盘,胜率,概率,新手,教程,策略,虚拟筹码
apple.description:
每一手牌，都是理解下一次决策的机会。

NOIR Poker 是一款离线无限注德州扑克练习应用。与电脑对手同桌，在引导中熟悉规则，在复盘中理解选择，再用同一副牌探索不同打法。无需注册，打开即可练习。

在牌桌上学会规则
互动新手引导从底牌、位置、盲注和下注轮次开始，逐步介绍加注、弃牌、全下与边池。四手引导练习之后，再独立完成一手牌。

练习自己的判断
选择 5–9 人桌、三个难度和八种训练风格，练习下注尺度、观察公开行动，以及应对不同对手。需要时可查看牌桌提示与牌型速查。

复盘行动背后的理由
牌局结束后，逐步查看自己与对手的行动。复盘结合行动前的公开信息、跟注价格和假设对手范围，使用启发式与模拟估算解释选择，不靠偷看对手底牌或最终输赢评价决策。

同一副牌，试试另一条路线
重打会恢复原始底牌、发牌顺序和起始筹码。换一种选择，观察牌局如何发展；也可以浏览本机保存的对局记录，回看之前的练习。

把胜率看得更清楚
在独立胜率计算器中设置底牌与公共牌，比较获胜、平局概率，并查看下一张能让该手牌领先的牌。计算会根据场景采用枚举或抽样，界面说明计算方式。

按自己的节奏练习
离线使用，画面、字体、音乐和分析逻辑都在本地。可调整人数、起始盲注、难度、风格、提示、音效、音乐与振动。界面支持 11 种语言。

所有筹码均为虚拟筹码，无现金价值，不能购买或兑换。应用没有奖金、真钱下注或真人对赌。复盘与胜率仅供学习参考，不保证最优打法或收益。

商店一次购买即可使用完整应用。无广告、订阅或应用内购买。
